opinions.text: C. A. 1st Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 823.] Motions of respondent for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and for appointment of counsel granted. It is ordered that Peter J. Rubin, Esquire, of Portland, Me., a member of the Bar of this Court, be, and he is hereby, appointed to serve as counsel for respondent in this case.
